svg.title: One graph execution, from llama.cpp to tsr_core
svg.desc: Swimlane timeline, time running down, with lanes llama.cpp, ggml-tesseract, tsr_transport, card DRAM and tsr_core. Model load: supports_op probe, set_tensor of weights, conversion and repacking, rows written at W_OFF on every channel. Each split: activations written to ch0 IO; MUL_MATs lowered with a program cache; program + END written to the idle CMD half; exec writes CMD_ADDR, CMD_COUNT and CTRL.START and blocks; the core prefetches from ch0 and runs LD, QACT, MVM (which gathers the y rows into the SPM) and ST per MUL_MAT and token tile; END sets DONE, or an error stops the core with DONE | ERR; the host reads the result back from ch0 IO and the CPU continues.
